Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`, the alignment GNU as gives m68k sections.

PC-relative references into another section are written with their 32-bit
displacement: GNU as cannot know how far away another section is and takes
the long form anyway, while rsasm in a flat image does know, and would choose
the 16-bit form.

=== absolute references into another section
 .text
 .p2align 2
 lea msg,%a0
 movel #msg,%d0
 movel msg,%d1
 jsr sub
 rts
 .data
 .p2align 2
 .space 0x100
msg: .long 1
sub: rts

=== pc-relative references into another section
 .text
 .p2align 2
 .cpu 68020
 lea (msg:l,%pc),%a1
 movew (msg:l,%pc),%d1
 bsrl sub
 rts
 .data
 .p2align 2
 .space 0x100
msg: .long 1
sub: rts

=== data across sections
 .text
 .p2align 2
entry:
 rts
 .data
 .p2align 2
 .long entry
 .long entry - .
 .word entry - .

=== sections start at their default alignment
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3

=== FPU operands reading labels in another section
 .text
 .p2align 2
 faddd msg,%fp1
 fbeql sub
 fdbne %d0,here
here: rts
 .data
 .p2align 2
 .space 0x100
msg: .long 1,2
sub: rts
